lessons.title: Story Time: The Doorbell Rang (Sharing Cookies)
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss the sharing theme in a story.
success_criteria: I can say how the characters shared.
I can say if it was fair.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what happens when more people arrive to share something.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story about sharing food fairly among a growing group, modelling discussion.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record whether the sharing in the story was fair.
key_questions: Was the sharing fair?
How do you know?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of the sharing/fairness theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a time you shared something fairly.

lessons.title: Halves Recap: Shapes and Quantities
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to find half of shapes and quantities confidently.
success_criteria: I can find half of a shape.
I can find half of a quantity to 20.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model finding half of shapes and quantities up to 20, consolidating understanding.
lessons.independent_task: Children find half of a range of shapes and quantities, recording answers.
key_questions: What is half of this shape?
What is half of this quantity?

differentiation.support: Find half of quantities to 10 with counters
differentiation.greater_depth: Find half of quantities to 20 without counters

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on halves — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Find half of a group of objects at home.

lessons.title: Writing About Sharing Fairly
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write sentences explaining how to share fairly.
success_criteria: I can write how to share fairly.
I can use a full sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the sharing story from Monday.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a sentence explaining a fair sharing method.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 sentences explaining how they would share something fairly.
key_questions: How would you share this fairly?
Can you write a sentence about it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note explanatory writing progress — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Practise sharing something fairly at home.

lessons.title: Quarters Recap: Shapes and Quantities
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to find a quarter of shapes and quantities confidently.
success_criteria: I can find a quarter of a shape.
I can find a quarter of a quantity to 20.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model finding a quarter of shapes and quantities up to 20, consolidating understanding.
lessons.independent_task: Children find a quarter of a range of shapes and quantities, recording answers.
key_questions: What is a quarter of this shape?
What is a quarter of this quantity?

differentiation.support: Find a quarter of quantities to 8 with counters
differentiation.greater_depth: Find a quarter of quantities to 20 without counters

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on quarters — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Find a quarter of a group of objects at home.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Sharing Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read sharing-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read sharing words.
I can read a sentence about sharing.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce/reinforce a grapheme, blending sharing-themed words (e.g. 'half', 'same', 'each').
lessons.independent_task: Children read sharing-themed word and sentence cards.
key_questions: Can you blend this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading sharing words over the week.

lessons.title: Sharing and Grouping Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve sharing and grouping problems confidently.
success_criteria: I can share a quantity equally.
I can group a quantity equally.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sharing and grouping from earlier terms.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model sharing and grouping quantities equally, consolidating understanding.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve a range of sharing and grouping problems using counters.
key_questions: How many each if shared fairly?
How many groups can you make?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve problems within 20, some without counters

lessons.assessment_notes: Consolidation check on early multiplication/division understanding — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Practise sharing and grouping objects at home.

lessons.title: Explaining How to Share Fairly
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain a fair sharing method to the class.
success_criteria: I can explain how to share fairly.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sharing methods learned this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes a clear explanation.
lessons.independent_task: Children explain a fair sharing method (e.g. sharing 12 sweets between 4 people) to a small group.
key_questions: How did you share this fairly?
Can you explain your method?

differentiation.greater_depth: Explain unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and mathematical explanation skill — evidence for ENG.SL1/MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Explain how you would share something fairly to your family.

lessons.title: Fraction and Sharing Word Problems
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to solve word problems involving fractions and sharing.
success_criteria: I can solve a halving/quartering problem.
I can solve a sharing problem.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's fraction and sharing learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model solving mixed word problems involving fractions and sharing.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve a mix of fraction and sharing word problems, showing working.
key_questions: What is half of this amount?
How would you share this fairly?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve problems within 20 with minimal support

lessons.assessment_notes: Record application of fractions and sharing to word problems — evidence for MATHS.N4/N3.
lessons.home_link: Make up a fraction or sharing word problem for your family.

lessons.title: Fractions and Sharing Quiz: Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions linked to sharing and fairness.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's sharing and fairness learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about sharing fairly, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: Why is it important to share fairly?
How would you solve this sharing problem?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on fair sharing.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Fractions and Sharing Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply all fraction and sharing skills learned this week in a mixed challenge.
success_criteria: I can find half and a quarter confidently.
I can share and group fairly.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the week's fraction and sharing content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a mixed review worksheet covering halves, quarters, sharing and grouping.
key_questions: What is half/a quarter of this?
How would you share this fairly?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: End-of-week fractions and sharing consolidation summary for each child — evidence for MATHS.N3/N4.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate the week's fractions and sharing learning.
lessons.home_link: Review fractions and sharing together over the weekend.
